name: test-triage.bash.opus.1
result:
I wrote `answer.json`. I ran the suite four times and got the same result every time: 400 tests, 394 pass, 3 fail, 2 skipped and 1 todo.

**Failing tests:**
- `test/mod07.test.js`, "parses dates in March": "March 31 should stay in March"
- `test/mod22.test.js`, "rounds half up": "2.5 should round to 3"
- `test/mod35.test.js`, "keeps order of equal keys": "equal keys must keep their order"

**Skipped (2):** "slow path of mod04" and "slow path of mod30", both with the reason "too slow on CI".

**Todo (1):** "streams large files".

The output also contains many "# fail-safe engaged" lines. These are just text the tests print to the console, not results from the runner, so they don't affect the counts above. I didn't change any other file.
